job.title: Finance Manager

company.name: Talenta Partners Group
company.description: Specializes in recruitment through direct search and HR consultants. Supports clients in acquiring top-level talent and matching candidates to professional projects.

job.summary: Recruiting a Finance Manager for one of our client companies.
responsibilities: Oversee preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements
Manage budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis processes
Monitor cash flow and working capital to ensure liquidity
Ensure compliance with accounting standards, tax regulations, and statutory reporting requirements
Coordinate with external auditors and manage the annual audit cycle
Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger functions
Control and analyze costs across departments to support profitability
Oversee the finance team's day-to-day operations and set performance objectives
Prepare financial reports and dashboards for senior management
Manage relationships with banks and financial institutions
Support month-end and year-end closing processes
Identify financial risks and propose mitigation strategies
Ensure finance and ERP systems accurately reflect company operations
Collaborate with department heads on budget planning and cost control

requirements.education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance / Accounting / Business Administration
requirements.experience_type: Proven experience in a finance management or senior accounting role
